problem: Two guarded oral-practice deployments restored the previous release after the canonical offline worker returned a stale CDN body. Other public assets matched the tested release.

observedDelivery.canonicalWorker: HTTP 200; CF-Cache-Status HIT; Cache-Control max-age=14400; SHA-256 matched the prior learner-audit worker
observedDelivery.singleUrlPurge: Registered token returned an authorization failure; no wider credential or zone-wide purge used
observedDelivery.cacheRulesInspection: Not available with the registered token; no rule-level cause inferred

repair: A deterministic 16-hex release ID covers the worker template, install manifest, icon, normalized pre-meta HTML and sorted public asset bytes. The emitted HTML and worker identify the same release without a circular hash.

Download and Check fetch fresh same-origin HTML with a unique query and no-store. Ordinary query fetches bypass the existing service-worker cache; only a validated release tag determines the fixed worker URL.
Registration uses /offline-worker.js?release=<version>. Fresh network metadata selects the latest version even when a downloaded shell and earlier worker URLs remain cached.
HTTP, network, invalid metadata, duplicate metadata and unexpected response failures use the existing error state. A failed check cannot silently reuse the older release.
The active downloaded shell remains pinned until explicit update activation. Recognition and removal accept existing canonical and new queried worker URLs.

The dedicated Italian origin adds one exact worker location with expires -1. Syntax checking and graceful reload passed; the original configuration is retained for rollback. Inherited security headers and other routes are preserved.

originCachePolicy.edgeObservation: New query responses still advertised max-age=14400; application release discovery does not rely on a successful purge or edge revalidation.

privacy: Owned disposable browsers and synthetic progress only. Public emitted assets remain the cache allowlist. No learner storage, source books, local audio or credentials added to the build or reports.
migrationLimit: An actual pre-fix downloaded shell cannot execute the new discovery helper until it receives current application code. If its old update check still serves a cached release, remove the offline download, reload online, then download again. This preserves local progress.
